contentEn:
Reno Stars has managed hundreds of kitchen renovations across Metro Vancouver. The shortest kitchen reno we completed in 2025 took 12 days; the longest luxury job ran 26 weeks. Here is what actually drives that range — and what each scope looks like in real weeks.

How Long Does Each Kitchen Renovation Take in Vancouver?

Vancouver kitchen renovation timelines in 2026 break into four distinct scopes:

  • Cosmetic refresh (no layout change): 2–4 weeks
  • Mid-range full reno (10–14 linear ft cabinets, no structural work): 6–10 weeks
  • Premium reno (layout change, custom cabinets, appliance package): 10–16 weeks
  • Luxury gut (open-concept, designer brands, structural work): 16–28 weeks

A cosmetic refresh keeps your existing cabinets and plumbing rough-in — trades finish faster because there is no demo or rewiring. A mid-range reno rips everything to the studs, reruns electrical and plumbing, and installs new semi-custom cabinets and quartz — the single biggest variable is cabinet lead time (4–6 weeks for Canadian-built semi-custom). Premium and luxury scopes add structural changes, custom millwork, and high-end appliance sourcing that individually add weeks.

What Actually Extends a Kitchen Timeline in Vancouver

Five factors routinely push Vancouver kitchen timelines past the baseline estimates above:

  • Cabinet lead time: Canadian-built semi-custom cabinets take 4–6 weeks after measurements are confirmed. Custom local millwork runs 8–14 weeks. Order early in the project.
  • Structural wall removal: Removing a load-bearing wall requires an engineer assessment, LVL beam fabrication, and a City of Vancouver / municipal building permit. Budget 2–4 weeks just for the structural package before demo begins.
  • Asbestos in pre-1990 homes: BC building code requires asbestos testing before demo in homes built before 1990. If asbestos is present, abatement adds 1–3 weeks and must be handled by a licensed contractor.
  • Strata buildings: Condos and townhouses restrict work hours (typically 9 am–5 pm weekdays), require freight elevator booking, and mandate construction dust protection. Budget an extra week inside the building envelope.
  • 200A panel upgrades: Adding induction cooking or an electric oven often requires a panel upgrade that must be coordinated with BC Hydro — that alone can add 2–4 weeks to permitting.

Kitchen Renovation Timeline: Start to Finish

A mid-range Vancouver kitchen renovation follows a predictable sequence:

  • Weeks 1–2: In-home assessment, 3D design rendering, material selection, permit application (if required)
  • Week 2–3: Cabinet measurements confirmed; order placed with manufacturer
  • Weeks 3–4: Demo — flooring, old cabinets, countertops, plumbing rough-in disconnected
  • Weeks 4–5: Electrical and plumbing rough-in; any structural work completed and inspected
  • Weeks 5–8: Cabinet installation (typically 3–5 days), countertop template and fabrication (1–2 weeks), tile backsplash
  • Weeks 8–10: Countertop install, sink and faucet set, appliances connected, final electrical (under-cabinet lighting, outlets), painting, final cleanup
  • Week 10: Walkthrough, BC building inspection sign-off, warranty registered

How Metro Vancouver Cities Affect Renovation Timeline

Permit timelines vary across Metro Vancouver municipalities:

  • Vancouver: Structural permits typically 3–5 weeks; fast-track available for minor work
  • Burnaby / New Westminster: 2–4 weeks for structural permits
  • Coquitlam / Port Coquitlam: 3–4 weeks; electronic submission speeds things
  • Richmond: 2–3 weeks for most kitchen scopes
  • Surrey / Delta: 3–5 weeks depending on scope and inspector availability
  • Langley / Maple Ridge: 2–4 weeks; smaller municipalities often faster

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a basic kitchen renovation take in Vancouver?

A basic cosmetic kitchen refresh — new countertop, cabinet hardware, fresh paint, no layout change — typically takes 2–4 weeks in Vancouver. No permit is required for cosmetic work, and your existing cabinets and plumbing rough-in stay in place, which is the main reason it finishes fast.

What is the longest part of a kitchen renovation timeline?

The longest single item is cabinet lead time. Canadian-built semi-custom cabinets take 4–6 weeks after measurements are confirmed. Custom millwork from a local shop runs 8–14 weeks. We order cabinets in week 2 while demolition is underway so the lead time overlaps with demo — but it still typically runs 4–6 weeks of pure waiting after measurements are locked.

Does a kitchen renovation require a permit in Vancouver?

Permits are required when moving gas lines, rerouting plumbing, upgrading an electrical panel, or removing a structural wall. Cosmetic work — refacing cabinets, replacing countertops, repainting — does not require a permit. If your kitchen renovation involves any of these items, Reno Stars handles the permit application and coordinates all required inspections.

Can I live in my home during a kitchen renovation?

Most homeowners stay in the home during a kitchen renovation. We set up a temporary kitchen setup (mini fridge, microwave, utility sink) and work room-by-room to minimize disruption. For a full gut renovation, some clients prefer to relocate for 2–3 weeks during demo and rough-in when the kitchen is not functional.

How much does a mid-range kitchen renovation cost in Vancouver in 2026?

A mid-range kitchen renovation in Vancouver — semi-custom cabinets, quartz countertops, new tile backsplash, mid-tier appliances — runs $40,000–$80,000 in 2026. A cosmetic refresh runs $25,000–$40,000. Premium renovations with custom cabinets and layout changes run $80,000–$150,000. Luxury designer kitchens reach $150,000–$300,000+. 溫哥華各類型廚房改造需要多長時間？

2026 年溫哥華廚房改造工期分為四個層級：

  • 基礎刷新（不改動佈局）：2–4 週
  • 中檔全面翻新（10–14 延尺櫃體，無結構工程）：6–10 週
  • 高檔翻新（佈局改動、定製櫃體、高端設備）：10–16 週
  • 豪華全面改造（開放式設計、設計師品牌、結構工程）：16–28 週

基礎刷新保留現有櫃體和管線預留口——因無拆建或線路重鋪，工程進度更快。中檔翻新則需拆除至結構層，重新鋪設電線和水管，並安裝新的半定製櫃體和石英石——最大變數是櫃體交貨期（加拿大製造的半定製櫃體需 4–6 週）。高檔和豪華項目涉及結構改動、定製木作和高檔電器採購，每項都會單獨增加工期。

什麼因素會延長溫哥華廚房改造工期

以下五個因素經常使溫哥華廚房改造工期超出基本預期：

  • 櫃體交貨期：加拿大製造的半定製櫃體在尺寸確認後需 4–6 週交貨。本地定製木作需 8–14 週。請在項目初期提前下單。
  • 拆除承重牆：拆除承重牆需工程師評估、LVL 橫梁製作，以及溫哥華市或所屬市政府建築許可。仅结构文件准备就需額外 2–4 週。
  • 1990 年前房屋的石棉檢測：BC 省建築規範要求 1990 年前建造的房屋在拆建前必須進行石棉檢測。如發現石棉，處理需額外 1–3 週，且必須由持證承包商進行。
  • 共管柏文及聯排別墅：施工時間受限於大樓規定（通常為工作日上午 9 點至下午 5 點），需預約貨梯，並實行防塵保護。預算室內工程額外增加一週。
  • 200 安培電箱升級：新增電磁爐或電烤箱通常需要電箱升級，並需與 BC Hydro 協調——僅此一項就可能增加 2–4 週的許可等待時間。

溫哥華廚房改造工序流程

中檔溫哥華廚房改造遵循以下標準工序：

  • 第 1–2 週：上門評估、3D 效果圖制作、建材選擇、許可申請（如需要）
  • 第 2–3 週：櫃體尺寸確認；下單至製造商
  • 第 3–4 週：拆建——地板、旧櫃體拆除、檯面拆除、管線預留口切斷
  • 第 4–5 週：水電管線安裝；結構工程完成並通過驗收
  • 第 5–8 週：櫃體安裝（通常 3–5 天）、檯面量尺及製作（ 1–2 週）、瓷磚背面安裝
  • 第 8–10 週：檯面安裝、水槽和龍頭安裝、電器接駁、最終電工（櫃下照明、插座）、噴漆、最終清潔
  • 第 10 週：竣工驗收、BC 省建築檢驗合格、質保登記完成

大溫各城市對裝修工期的影响

大溫各城市的許可證審批時間有所不同：

  • 溫哥華：結構許可通常需 3–5 週；小額工程可申請快速通道
  • 本拿比 / 新西敏：結構許可 2–4 週
  • 高貴林 / 滿地可：3–4 週；電子遞交可加快進度
  • 列治文：大多數廚房項目 2–3 週
  • 素里 / 三角洲：根據項目規模和督察可用性，約 3–5 週
  • 蘭里 / 楓樹嶺：2–4 週；規模較小的市政府通常審批更快

常見問題

溫哥華基礎廚房改造需要多長時間？

溫哥華基礎 Cosmetic 廚房刷新——更換檯面、櫃體五金、重新噴漆、不改動佈局——通常需 2–4 週。基礎刷新無需申請許可，且保留現有櫃體和管線預留口，這是工期較短的主要原因。

廚房改造中最耗時的是哪個環節？

最耗時的單項是櫃體交貨期。加拿大製造的半定製櫃體在尺寸確認後需 4–6 週交貨。本地定製木作需 8–14 週。聚星裝修在第 2 週下單櫃體，與拆建同步進行——但交貨後仍需 4–6 週組裝等待時間。

溫哥華廚房改造需要申請許可證嗎？

移動燃氣管道、改動水管線路、升級電箱或拆除承重牆時，需要申請許可證。基礎刷新工程（如櫃體翻新、更換檯面、重新噴漆）無需許可證。如您的廚房改造涉及上述任何項目，聚星裝修將代為辦理許可證申請，並協調所有必需的檢驗。

裝修期間可以繼續住在房子裡嗎？

大多數業主在廚房改造期間仍可住在屋內。我們會搭建臨時迷你廚房（小型冰箱、微波爐、 utility sink ），分區域施工，盡量減少對日常生活的影響。對於全面拆建工程，部分業主選擇在拆建和水電管線階段（約 2–3 週）暫時搬到其他地方居住。

2026 年溫哥華中檔廚房改造費用是多少？

2026 年溫哥華中檔廚房改造——半定製櫃體、石英石檯面、新瓷磚背面、高性價比電器——造價為 40,000 至 80,000 加元。基礎刷新為 25,000 至 40,000 加元。高檔翻新（定製櫃體、佈局改動）為 80,000 至 150,000 加元。豪華設計師廚房達 150,000 至 300,000 加元以上。詳見我們的《溫哥華廚房改造費用指南》獲取 2026 年各層級完整費用明細。
